links.outcome: Clinical fidelity and safety-oriented dimensions of 53 medical LLM benchmarks audited with MedCheck checklist
links.effect: Benchmarks show a profound disconnect from clinical practice, unmitigated data contamination risks, and systematic neglect of robustness and uncertainty awareness (no numeric rates in abstract).
links.quote: Our analysis uncovers widespread, systemic issues, including a profound disconnect from clinical practice, a crisis of data integrity due to unmitigated contamination risks, and a systematic neglect of safety-critical evaluation dimensions like model robustness and uncertainty awareness.

unlisted_practices: Lifecycle-oriented 46-criterion checklist (MedCheck) for assessing the quality of medical LLM benchmarks
Data contamination risk mitigation in benchmark design

screen.reason: The study conducts an empirical meta-evaluation/audit of 53 medical LLM benchmarks using a newly developed framework (MedCheck) assessing clinical fidelity, safety, and data contamination risks.
